role: Deputy Director, Office of Federal-State Relations, West Virginia
stance_basis: letter certifies procedural compliance and concurs with enclosed comments without expressing support or opposition to the project
summary: Robert V. Barill, Deputy Director of the Office of Federal-State Relations for West Virginia, submitted a letter on behalf of the State Clearinghouse certifying that the review requirements of NEPA and OMB Circular A-95 had been met and concurring with the enclosed memorandum. His letter transmits the substantive comments of David Morgan (a planner in his office) rather than expressing a personal or agency position for or against the ORV regulations. The enclosed reviewer's comments raise specific concerns about ORV operator licensing and safety criteria on Interior lands.
complaint_summary: Barill certifies on behalf of the West Virginia State Clearinghouse that NEPA Section 102(2)(c) and OMB Circular A-95 review requirements have been met, and transmits enclosed comments from planner David Morgan raising concerns about ORV operator licensing, uniform federal licensing standards, and type-specific operator competency requirements.

statement.text:
The State Clearinghouse has reviewed the Draft Environmental Statement for Implementation of Executive Order #11644 and concurs fully with this memorandum.
This will certify that the requirements of Section 102(2)(c) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 and the U.S. Office of Management and Budget Circular A-95 have been met.
A copy of the comments of Mr. David Morgan, Planner, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation of the Office of Federal-State Relations is enclosed for your further information.
